# Gergely Vámossy — research site

> AI/LLM governance, epistemic infrastructure, mathematical ontology, and machine-checkable non-self-approval.

Site: https://vamossy.com
Author: Gergely Vámossy / QIERA
Contact: gergo@qiera.io
Source: https://github.com/Gergo89/llm-governance-toolkit

## Primary publications

- [Seven-Layer Governance Architecture](https://vamossy.com/research/seven-layer-governance): a research program in preparation. The author describes seven governance layers (Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Evolution, Human Qualia, God / Electromagnetic Governance) and uses the term "god infra". Layer definitions and evidence are not yet supplied. Author claims on this page are recorded as statements, not as independently established facts.
- [Non-Self-Approving AI-Assisted Derivation](https://vamossy.com/research/non-self-approving-ai-assisted-derivation): a method that lets a model reason without letting it rule. Governs authority, not correctness.
- [The Mathematics Ontology Bible](https://vamossy.com/research/mathematics-ontology-bible): a complete map of mathematical structure, from foundations to frontiers.
- [LLM Governance Toolkit](https://vamossy.com/llm-governance-toolkit): public documentation for the toolkit. Source remains on GitHub; this site does not expose repository internals.

## How to read this site

- Research content is HTML, not PDF-only.
- Canonical artifacts are downloadable from their publication pages.
- Status language in the sources is preserved: candidate, recommendation, working basis, and unvalidated claims are not upgraded.
- The human remains the authority slot.
